name: Lacustrine-Corbel
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond geothermal vent fields the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Nothing about the signal of unknown origin appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
